title: Beyond One World: Benchmarking Super Heros in Role-Playing Across Multiversal Contexts
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not measure any aspects of faith or religion. It focuses on adherence to fictional superhero canons and moral reasoning based on philosophical and psychological frameworks, such as factual recall of character backstories ('Canon Events') and responses to ethically-charged scenarios ('Moral Dilemmas').
findings: The paper does not contain findings related to religion, as its focus is on character consistency and moral reasoning within fictional superhero universes.
